data.content_ref: inline:The dependence claim overstates the semantic requirement. The stated REFUTED IF is that the linear pricing model is self-grounding and needs no contrast with a nonlinear alternative. But routine, domain-default pricing models (uniform unit rate) are epistemically meaningful without adversarial contrast: a solver applies the standard convention unless told otherwise, which is self-grounding in a way that does not require SRC_004's counterfactual. By defining refutation so narrowly (only if 'self-grounding'), the target omits the weaker but sufficient condition that the linear model is simply the default convention, under which there is no dependence on SRC_004. The proposed adversarial dependence is therefore not robust to the default-convention counterexample.
